decisions.reason: As a close-to-core product line with several variants and dedicated web presentation, it is likely above or near aspiration and the firm's slack supports keeping it while demand information accumulates.
This supplement fits the firm's consumer-health expansion, had a clear launch push, and in a large investing firm uncertain early results would usually not justify withdrawal yet.
Although marketed less prominently than A or B, it still builds on existing capabilities and is cheap to carry, so management would likely continue it unless results clearly fall below aspiration.

Its narrower niche and weaker visibility make it more vulnerable, but because it is close to the established offer and the firm has resources for experimentation, it would probably be retained for another year.

A documented problem signal at launch combined with its more distant fit raises the chance that management judges it below aspiration and reallocates resources to safer portfolio extensions or new development.
